scope: Local deterministic engine and workflow model; no live sanctions or legal verification

checks.name: Confirmed bank essentials eligible; no preferences means no score
Missing provider criteria are conditional, never assumed support
Unapproved uploaded policy cannot publish eligibility
Known country prohibition excludes requested product
Unknown country cannot be silently accepted
Owner nationality and residence are independently evaluated
Incoming and outgoing geographic rules are independent
Essential unsupported currency excludes; preferred currency changes score
Known count/amount limit enforced
Noncomparable reporting currency is conditional
Unmapped narrative policy conditions prevent automatic eligibility
Expired or future policy cannot establish eligibility
Alternative product OR: rejected offer cannot veto supported alternative
Combined application needs both requested components
Private residence, tax residence and nationality stay separate
Financing maximum amount is enforced
Correspondent own-funds limit distinct from client-funds limit
Optional blank fraud/chargeback not invented as zero
Screening subjects deduplicated; named controller role retained
Outbox is idempotent and never claims an email was sent
Admin cannot approve sharing on applicant behalf
Withdrawn approval is invalid for release
Erasure activity suppression cannot affect another applicant account
Another applicant cannot withdraw an unrelated case
